mapper.sql: select id, competition_id, participation_id, team_id, reviewer_id, reviewer_name, assignment_status, assigned_by, assigned_time, update_time from competition_review_assignment
mapper.select: where competition_id = #{competitionId} order by participation_id asc, reviewer_id asc
where participation_id = #{participationId} order by reviewer_id asc
mapper.insert: insert into competition_review_assignment ( competition_id, participation_id, team_id, reviewer_id, reviewer_name, assignment_status, assigned_by, assigned_time, update_time ) values ( #{competitionId}, #{participationId}, #{teamId}, #{reviewerId}, #{reviewerName}, #{assignmentStatus}, #{assignedBy}, #{assignedTime}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.update: update competition_review_assignment set reviewer_name = #{reviewerName}, assignment_status = #{assignmentStatus}, assigned_by = #{assignedBy}, assigned_time = #{assignedTime}, update_time = #{updateTime} where id = #{id}
